decisive_finding.cause: LifecyclePlan fields are publicly constructible and apply validates only self-consistent structure before executing effects. A caller can forge host-write effects, set writes_host_state=false, recompute the documented digest, and bypass plan-time write authorization.

focused_verification.interpretation: The green suite is diagnostic and lacks the decisive forged-plan false-pass control.

corrective_action: Seal lifecycle plans behind crate-private construction or bind apply to a root-issued authorization and canonical transition re-derivation. Reject forged, deserialized, effect-expanded, write-flag-mismatched, stale, substituted, and replayed plans before adapter effects.
claim_ceiling: Source candidate remains under REWORK. Package, marketplace, install, cache, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, runtime, lifecycle journey, readiness, release, and completion claims remain withheld.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim readiness, release, or completion.
